format: Veldren source-content snapshot, not a Vervesis schema

coordinateEvidence.engineUnits: Unconfirmed; do not assume physical metres

terrain.height: Little-endian float32 grid vertices; rows z, columns x. Width+1 by height+1.
terrain.walk: Little-endian float32 cell-centre walk heights including bridges.
terrain.navigation: Static Uint8 tile blockage after resolving lazy cell values. Moving actors, doors and quest gates remain state-dependent.
terrain.triangles: NW-SW-SE for local z>=x, otherwise NW-NE-SE.
